description: This file defines the SocketsTrace class, which implements ISocketsTrace interface for logging socket connection events, utilizing Microsoft.Extensions.Logging. It contains methods for various socket-related trace events, with some methods using LoggerMessage attribute for efficient logging.

classes.name: SocketsTrace
classes.description: A class providing logging for socket connection events, implementing ISocketsTrace, using an injected ILogger instance.

methods.name: ConnectionRead
methods.description: Logs socket connection read event; implementation currently suppressed due to verbosity.

methods.name: ConnectionReadFin
methods.description: Logs that a connection received a FIN packet, with event ID 6.

methods.name: ConnectionWriteFin
methods.description: Logs that a connection is sending a FIN packet, with event ID 7.

methods.name: ConnectionWrite
methods.description: Logs socket connection write event; implementation currently suppressed.

methods.name: ConnectionWriteCallback
methods.description: Logs callback for connection write completion; implementation currently suppressed.

methods.name: ConnectionError
methods.description: Logs a connection error with exception details, with event ID 13.

methods.name: ConnectionReset
methods.description: Logs that a connection was reset, with event ID 19.

methods.name: ConnectionPause
methods.description: Logs that a connection was paused, with event ID 4.

methods.name: ConnectionResume
methods.description: Logs that a connection was resumed, with event ID 5.

methods.name: BeginScope
